concerns.asked: Show that the measured stacking fraction tracks the suppression of TC and Msat, and explain how the fraction was obtained.
concerns.response: The fraction plot was removed, the method stated and the fraction called a lower bound (p. 5, 8). A stacking-variation model links an assumed linear AA fraction to TC(p) (p. 12), with a caveat that no simple conclusion can be drawn.
concerns.judgment: The method request was met; the quantitative link was replaced by caveats and a modelled, not measured, fraction.
concerns.still_open: The Methods ~80% R-3 still disagrees with 0.60 in Table S4.

concerns.asked: Make the simulations reach the loss of ferromagnetism and use pressure-dependent exchange.
concerns.response: J1(p), JL(p) and MAE(p) are computed (p. 10-11, Fig. 6a, S7); an ABC-only control does not lower TC (p. 10); TC vanishes at 73% AA (p. 27) and a simulated TC(p) is compared with data (p. 12).
concerns.judgment: The likely request was met with new calculations.
concerns.still_open: A stricter reader could still question the site-random disorder and the single 5 GPa exchange set.

concerns.asked: Justify ordered A-A stacking against random stacking or in-plane disorder.
concerns.response: The 'only viable option' claim is replaced by two scenarios the data cannot separate (p. 6). Reciprocal-space maps before and after deformation are fitted with a paracrystal model, giving ~10 nm blocks (p. 8). The occupancy is corrected to 2/3 (p. 13).
concerns.judgment: The claim was honestly narrowed and the ambient-pressure stacking analysis is new.
concerns.still_open: No analysis of honeycomb rods or diffuse scattering in the high-pressure data.

concerns.asked: Document pressure calibration, hydrostaticity and how each run was loaded.
concerns.response: Overpressure error bars and a redesigned cell are added (p. 4, 22); loading at room temperature with ruby is stated (p. 14); the hydrostatic limit is corrected to 10.5 GPa with photos in two media (p. 28-30).
concerns.judgment: The documentation request was largely met.
concerns.still_open: Pressure at low temperature is still not measured or estimated.

concerns.asked: Measure the magnetization of a decompressed sample to test whether the effect is reversible.
concerns.response: FM recovers with unchanged TC and Msat after 10 GPa (p. 3, Fig. S1b). XRD after 21.5 GPa keeps P-3m1 (p. 5), and the authors argue P-3m1 was not yet stabilized at 10 GPa (p. 13).
concerns.judgment: The test was done and reported.
concerns.still_open: Magnetization after decompression from above 21.5 GPa would test the mechanism more directly.

concerns.asked: Replace the questionable TC fit, add data near pc and show run-to-run spread.
concerns.response: The power-law fit is gone; pc = 5.8 GPa by extrapolation with no FM at 6.24 GPa (p. 3). AC data join Fig. 1 (p. 4) and two runs differing by ~1 GPa are in Fig. S1a (p. 22).
concerns.judgment: The likely request was met with new data.
concerns.still_open: The TC definition and an uncertainty on pc are still not given.

concerns.asked: Discuss whether negative thermal expansion and the Ehrenfest relation explain the negative dTC/dP.
concerns.response: A new paragraph cites Kozlenko et al. and argues the thermodynamic approach does not apply to vdW magnets (p. 3).
concerns.judgment: The topic is addressed, but whether the argument satisfies the referee cannot be judged without the report.
concerns.still_open: The dismissal is qualitative; no estimate of dTC/dP from the Ehrenfest relation is given.

concerns.asked: Describe earlier pressure studies of CrBr3 fairly and state what is new.
concerns.response: The introduction now gives Yoshida's -2 K/GPa, Lis et al.'s extrapolation, Raman at 9.5 GPa and a strain prediction (p. 2).
concerns.judgment: Context was added as likely asked.
concerns.still_open: The 'first direct evidence' wording is kept.

concerns.asked: Support or tone down the claim of an antiferromagnetic phase above pc.
concerns.response: The abstract and conclusions now attribute the loss to AFM-coupled stackings and defer the phase to microscopic probes (p. 1, 13). No new data above pc were added.
concerns.judgment: Wording was softened as likely asked.
concerns.still_open: Page 12 still states the structure is AFM with zero bulk moment.

concerns.asked: Account for magnetic anisotropy and quasi-2D effects in the TC model.
concerns.response: MAE versus pressure is computed (p. 10, Fig. S7) and finite-size and domain effects are discussed (p. 12).

concerns.asked: Reconcile the Raman transition pressure with XRD and published Raman.
concerns.response: The Raman change is placed near 10 GPa and compared with 15 GPa in a new reference, with sample state as a possible cause (p. 9).
concerns.judgment: A comparison was added; the assignment itself is unchanged.
concerns.still_open: Mode symmetry and the metallization claim are still not supported.

concerns.asked: Correct captions, labels and the occupancy error.
concerns.response: Several captions, spellings and labels are fixed and the occupancy is 2/3 (p. 6, 13, 14).
concerns.still_open: Space group 150, duplicate equation numbers and 289 vs 296 K remain.
